browser.kind: independent browser acceptance with actual keyboard and rendering
browser.startingRecipe: Fresh muted browser; title Space,Enter selects Easy; open map; click logical68,77; Space,Right,Space; hold Space to fly. Use the authored altitude controller in tests/browser/flight-lightning.spec.js. No private game state is written.
browser.clock: Frozen at2026-01-01T00:00:01Z before asset loading; advance display in8ms increments. Game device clocks remain separate.
browser.assertions: A natural strike clears throttle despite the prior physical Space hold. Speed decreases without any new key; fresh Space+Down changes heading, accelerates and climbs. All held keys are released, diagnostics remain hidden, and browser errors fail the run.

comparisonRules: Exact source hashes/table targets/call bytes, pending-key and neutral-input assertions; exact required strike tile/y/frame. Strict directional comparisons for throttle deceleration and new-input recovery, not a pixel or hardware timing comparison. Missing originals, no strike, unsupported paths, incomplete waits and unconsumed queued P fail.
exclusions: No new whole-original lightning/flight replay or pixel comparison.
Component P timing is an authored adversarial port trigger, not independent native timing evidence.
Browser key holds use the documented digital adapter; original keyboard typematic/IRQ alignment remains unverified.
Hard winning-flight and alternate-jungle completion remain unfinished investigations; exploratory failures are not acceptance passes.

fittedInputs.dependency: Trigger selected after exploratory observation of the port's generated strike; scope is conditional input ordering.
